climate: Cabernet Sauvignon, Merlot, Chardonnay and Syrah sit in their sweet spot, so the wines can show the style they are known for.
A dry climate, with little rain while the vines grow. Water is scarce and the dry air keeps disease down.

blurb.text: A Columbia Valley AVA in Grant County, Washington, near Mattawa. It is primarily known for Merlot and Cabernet Sauvignon, and Cabernet is 47 percent of plantings.
